STYLE: 2D hand-drawn action comic game art, Chinese ink-wash inspired, bold dark-brown ink outlines (#2B1D16), flat colors with one hard cel-shadow tone, subtle rice-paper texture, slightly chibi proportions (head-to-body 1:3), strong readable silhouettes, ink splatter accents, top-left light source, top-down three-quarter view at 45 degrees, Late Eastern Han dynasty China setting, original designs, suitable for a top-down action roguelike.
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production rig-cutout rebuilding of the reference character, not a new costume. Same lean blue-grey Han archer as reference with cream headwrap, leather vest, cloth trousers, wrist wraps, long bow and quiver. Preserve reference head/body ratio. Bow gripped in nearer hand to right/front of body, away from face. Quiver as separate back attachment.
Exactly 8 disconnected body components in a strict 4x2 sheet. ALL pieces in the same right-facing SIDE three-quarter camera as reference idle. Top row: right-facing head with COMPLETE short neck stump; right-facing torso without head or limbs, COMPLETE collar and shoulder/hip sockets; far arm from shoulder to fist; near arm from shoulder to fist. Bottom row: far leg from hip to foot; near leg from hip to foot; separate entire weapon; separate back attachment. Reconstruct hidden surfaces: rounded shoulder and hip upper ends must extend at least ten source pixels under torso, neck extends under collar, complete upper sleeves under shoulder overlap. Torso must contain full hidden waist behind arms. Do NOT include a frontal head or frontal symmetrical torso. Keep all components clean, same consistent scale physically; head size matched reference rather than filling its cell. Space objects far apart, fully transparent all empty space, no dirt platforms, no shadows, no ink splatter outside objects. No labels, text, numbers, logos, grid lines or watermark.
